title: Measured page titles use exact writable and brand owners without contradictory planner repairs
steps: Check brand-owned and ordinary measured titles on kept applicable blocks, including unknown, hidden, dropped and unwritable variants.
Project a stored page title through exact native path, sample, owner and desktop/phone measurements, then run planner, writer index, full write and live read-back.
Exercise native refusal and a dropped-page title in a kept shared masthead; attempt to resume paid runs frozen on previous checker versions.
expect: Brand-owned titles pass the planner without forbidden writer claims; unknown title declarations remain kit failures.
Only an exact measured title receives a writable declaration and measured limit; unrelated or conflicting stored fields remain inaccessible, and released kit/map/plan inputs remain unchanged.
Native refusal and reopened live values fail; a projected title of a dropped page never enters closing writes. Old paid runs refuse before preparation or provider calls.
fence: exact measured title joins and exact brand name-slot ownership; no prompt changes, arbitrary stored-field writes, native validation bypass or automatic paid-run migration
